_: Voices designed for the cast (npm run short -- --design <id>), by character. Delete one to design it again.

conehead.brief: A deranged, high, nasal, wet voice belonging to a grinning cone-headed creature. Sing-song and far too cheerful, spit bubbling on every S, sudden manic giggles, voice cracking and wobbling, unsettling pauses in the wrong places. Abrasive and off-putting.

bigeye.brief: A paranoid, intense, too-loud old man who sees everything, gravelly and strained, hissing through yellow teeth, every sentence an accusation, eye twitching in his voice.

redeye.brief: A dry, cracked, sleep-deprived whisper, raspy and flat and eerily calm, as if staring without blinking, with long unnerving pauses and a twitch catching in the throat.

droopy.brief: An extremely slow, sagging, monotone old voice whose pitch droops at the end of every phrase, long exhausted sighs, words slurring and dripping downward like melting wax, as if falling asleep mid-word.
